summary.text: Alan Gross is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the September 8 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Gross was also a Democratic candidate for Cheshire 10 in 2024, when he advanced from the September 10 primary but finished fourth in the two-seat general election, which Barrett Faulkner and Sly Karasinski won.
